summary: Refined briefing for the Gap section's three-phone composition: center Smart Recommendation phone as clear uncropped focal point (~8% wider than sides), side phones (Home/New Task) equal size with only an ~8px offset (no staircase), full screenshot geometry preservation, hover/selection-immune geometry, label copy/contrast, and mobile balance. No backend/API surface backs any of these purely visual/CSS criteria (static portfolio content). Added 4 new browser checks (gap-center-phone-prominent-uncropped, gap-side-phones-equal-no-staircase, gap-hover-selection-no-geometry-change, gap-labels-contrast-and-copy, gap-mobile-balanced-no-overflow — 5 new) and re-ran 1 pre-existing check (gap-screenshots-aspect-ratio-contain) to confirm no regression. All 6 checks passed. Visual screenshots confirm the center phone shows 23:43 time, notch, Wi-Fi/battery icons, sits ~24px higher and ~8% wider than the side phones which differ in y by exactly 8px; hovering/clicking any phone left bounding boxes and img transforms unchanged (delta 0); label colors resolved to near-white (oklab lightness ~1) with alpha 0.6 for side labels vs 0.85 for the center label (stronger contrast) while copy text matched exactly; mobile (390x844) preserved the same ~8% ratio/8px offset with no horizontal overflow and unchanged dark background/copy/buttons.
backend_note: No app-specific backend endpoints back any of the 6 criteria in this briefing (static, purely visual/CSS-driven Gap composition); no backend test files were added.

checks.criterion: Smart Recommendation is the clear focal phone without cropping
checks.name: gap-center-phone-prominent-uncropped
checks.evidence: centerBox.width=189.06 vs homeBox.width=174.88/newTaskBox.width=174.88 => ratio 1.081 (~8.1% wider); center y=225.3 above home y=249.3 and newTask y=257.3; img naturalWidth/Height ratio within 10% of 921:2000. Screenshot shows full 23:43 status bar, Dynamic Island, Wi-Fi, battery, top border, and bottom content on center phone.

checks.criterion: Side phones frame the center without a staircase composition
checks.name: gap-side-phones-equal-no-staircase
checks.evidence: homeBox and newTaskBox widths/heights identical (174.875 x 361.66); both y (249.3, 257.3) greater than centerBox.y (225.3); yDelta between New Task and Home = 8px, well under the 15px staircase threshold.

checks.criterion: All screenshots preserve their original content and geometry
checks.name: gap-screenshots-aspect-ratio-contain
checks.evidence: Re-run by name only (persisted script): all 3 slots visible, images loaded, object-fit=contain, overflow=visible, rendered ratio matches natural 921:2000 within tolerance at desktop(1280x900) and mobile(390x844), no stretching/clipping.

checks.criterion: Phone hover and selection cannot change image geometry
checks.name: gap-hover-selection-no-geometry-change
checks.evidence: Captured bounding box + img computed transform for all 3 slots before/during hover on each phone and after clicking/selecting New Task; all boxes and transforms ('none') were byte-identical (delta 0px) across all states.

checks.criterion: Labels have stronger contrast while preserving exact copy
checks.name: gap-labels-contrast-and-copy
checks.evidence: innerText exact matches: 'START WITH TIME', 'SMART RECOMMENDATION', 'CONTEXT & PRIORITY'. Computed color oklab lightness ~0.9999 (near-white/off-white) for all three; alpha 0.6 for side labels (Home/New Task) vs 0.85 for the center label, confirming stronger contrast on the central label.

checks.criterion: The refined hierarchy remains balanced on mobile and does not affect the rest of Gap
checks.name: gap-mobile-balanced-no-overflow
checks.evidence: At 390x844: centerBox width 111.3 vs homeBox 103.0 => ratio 1.081 (within 5-8%+ tolerance), center y=279.4 above home y=303.4/newTask y=311.4, y-delta=8px; document.scrollWidth(390)==clientWidth(390) i.e. no horizontal overflow; VIEW PROJECT / READ CASE STUDY buttons visible; section background rgb(15,23,42) (dark) unchanged.
